name: eSheep
author: Jellyfrog
description: The '90s desktop pet, for Omarchy. Sheep walk along the bottom of the screen, climb onto the top edge of your Hyprland windows, and can be picked up and dropped anywhere.

barWidget.description: Desktop pets that walk your screen and climb your windows.

schema.label: Size
schema.description: Sprite magnification. The sheep is drawn at 40x40 pixels.

schema.label: Climb on windows
schema.description: Land on the top edge of a window and walk along it.

schema.label: Bring friends
schema.description: Some animations arrive with a second pet in tow.

schema.label: Keep off the bar
schema.description: Treat the Omarchy bar as the edge of the world.

schema.label: Roam between monitors
schema.description: Walk from one screen onto the next where they touch. Ignored while "Keep to one workspace" is on.

schema.label: Keep to one workspace
schema.description: A pet stays on the workspace it appeared on, instead of floating over all of them.
